title: AXIS Appoints Rahil Jogani as Head of Technology & Artificial Intelligence Strategy
summary: PEMBROKE, Bermuda, July 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - AXIS Capital Holdings Limited (“AXIS Capital,” “AXIS” or the “Company”) (NYSE: AXS) today announced that it has hired Rahil Jogani to the newly created role of Head of Technology Artificial Intelligence (AI) Strategy. He will be based in the New York office and report to Group Chief Operations Officer Ann Haugh. Mr. Jogani is responsible for shaping the Company’s enterprise technology and AI agenda, helping define those strategic priorities, and advancing the adoption of AI and emerging technologies across the business. His work will include identifying measurable business outcomes, including enhanced underwriting insight, claims analysis, portfolio management and risk selection advantage. “Rahil brings direct, practical experience leading AI and technology-enabled transformations across a range of highly regulated global financial services companies.
